game: Super Mario Bros. Wonder – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park

campaign.structure: 6 numbered worlds (Pipe-Rock Plateau, Fluff-Puff Peaks, Shining Falls, Sunbaked Desert, Fungi Mines, Deep Magma Bog) + Petal Isles hub + optional Special World.
campaign.bosses: Only 4 of 6 worlds have a Bowser Jr. palace boss (Pipe-Rock Plateau, Fluff-Puff Peaks, Sunbaked Desert, Deep Magma Bog). Shining Falls and Fungi Mines award their Royal Seed via non-boss courses. Final boss: Castle Bowser at 'The Final Battle! Bowser's Rage Stage' in Petal Isles.
campaign.royalSeeds: 7 total (one per numbered world + one from Bowser), gate access to Castle Bowser.
campaign.specialWorld: Unlocked per-world via hidden Propeller Flower secret exits (NOT a seed-count threshold). ~10-11 courses including 'The Final Test: Wonder Gauntlet' and secret 'The Final-Final Test: Badge Marathon' (unlocks only after 100%-checkmarking every course in the game; rewards the 'Sound Off?' badge).

collectiblesAndCompletion.wonderSeeds: 225 total (community figure, medium/low confidence, not officially confirmed).
collectiblesAndCompletion.badges: 24 in the base game (9 Action, 11 Boost, 4 Expert).
collectiblesAndCompletion.standees: 144 total (12 characters x 12 poses each); revival item in multiplayer, bought randomly from Poplin Shops.
collectiblesAndCompletion.poplinShops: 11 Poplin Shops + 1 Special World Standee Shop.
collectiblesAndCompletion.sixMedals: Save-file medals for: (1) beat the game/credits, (2) all Wonder Seeds, (3) all Flower Coins, (4) all Goal Pole tops, (5) all Badges, (6) all Standees. All six -> alternate title screen.

systems.characters: Mario, Luigi, Peach, Daisy, 3 Toad colors, Nabbit, 3 Yoshi colors (base). Nabbit/Yoshis take no damage but can't transform via power-ups.
systems.noPercentStat: No numeric completion percentage anywhere — only the discrete medals.

bellabelPark.premise: New hub added in the Switch 2 Edition: an ancient park-shaped ruin in the Flower Kingdom, discovered by Captain Toad, accessed via an entrance in Pipe-Rock Plateau. Paid content bundled in the Switch 2 Edition / Upgrade Pack, not free to existing owners.
bellabelPark.structure: 23 attractions: 17 Local Multiplayer Plaza (7 co-op + 10 competitive, up to 4 players/GameShare) + 6 Game Room Plaza (up to 8 local wireless / 12 online).
bellabelPark.trainingCamp: Camp Central: 74 Toad Brigade Training Camp challenges (1-5 star), solo-capable, earns 'Bellabel Water' currency, drives a rank progression (Aspiring Brigade Member -> ... -> Legendary Explorer, exact ladder uncertain).
bellabelPark.sprouts: 31 sprouts total, watered with Bellabel Water for randomized rewards (Dual Badges, Poplin Band instruments, Greeting/Decorative Flowers) from a shared pool — this is a genuine RNG-gated but bounded system (pool exhausts, then only cosmetic filler drops).
bellabelPark.newBadges: 16-18 Dual Badges (exact count disputed between scouts) + 3 Support Badges (Fruit Lover, Life Booster, Zero Damage) + 'All Flower Power' (reward for beating all 7 Koopalings). Combined total reported as ~42, arithmetic doesn't perfectly reconcile.
bellabelPark.koopalingBosses: 7 new Koopaling boss courses reportedly added to the WORLD MAP (not just inside Bellabel Park), unlocked via 'Brigade Tent' icons on base-game world map. This is a significant, only medium-confidence claim that would mean Bellabel Park content extends into the main campaign map, not just the separate hub.
bellabelPark.newCharacters: Rosalina & Co-Star Luma (playable, uses Joy-Con 2 mouse controls), Recruit Poplin, Brigade Blue Toad (NPCs).

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved — do not build trophies on exact per-world course counts.

conflicts.claimA: 225 (scouts A, B, C all cite this)
conflicts.resolution: 225 is the more frequently cited and consistent figure across independent scouts; treat as medium confidence and avoid a trophy that states the exact number in its description.

conflicts.claimA: 24 base + 16 Dual + 3 Support = ~42 or 43 (scout B, category sum mismatch)
conflicts.claimB: 24 base + 18 Dual + 3 Support + 1 (All Flower Power) = different total (scout C)
conflicts.resolution: Unresolved exact count. Do not build a trophy that names an exact combined badge number for the Switch 2 Edition; 'all badges' as a medal-based trophy is safe since the game itself tracks it, a numeric claim in the description is not.

conflicts.topic: Existence of a 7th save-file medal for Bellabel Park
conflicts.claimA: Exists — ties to Koopaling missions, Training Camp challenges, Poplin reports, Poplin Band, decor purchases (scout C, single GameFAQs forum thread, low confidence)
conflicts.claimB: No mention of a 7th medal from scouts A or B, who found only the base 6 medals
conflicts.resolution: NOT verified by any wiki/official source, only a forum paraphrase. Too risky to build a trophy on a medal that may not exist. Recommend treating Bellabel Park completion as tracked by the game's individual systems (Koopaling clears, Training Camp rank, Sprout rewards) rather than asserting a numbered medal exists.

conflicts.topic: Do the 7 new Koopaling bosses live on the base-game world map or purely inside Bellabel Park?
conflicts.claimA: Base-game world map, via 'Brigade Tent' icons, one per Koopaling (scout C, medium confidence)
conflicts.claimB: Scout A (campaign specialist) found no evidence of this and described the core 6-world story as structurally unchanged, treating Bellabel Park as a separate hub
conflicts.resolution: This materially changes whether Koopaling fights count as 'base game' or 'Bellabel Park DLC' content for Rule 14 purposes. Needs user confirmation before design.

gaps: No official Nintendo source for exact Wonder Seed total, exact per-world course counts, exact Dual Badge count, or the 7th-medal claim.
No confirmed UI screen name/location for: Standee collection screen, Bellabel Water counter, Sprout-growth counter, Royal Seed counter.
Unconfirmed whether Bellabel Park's 23 attractions have any persistent per-attraction completion tracking (high scores, clear counts) versus being purely session-based.
Unconfirmed whether solo play is possible for any Attraction Central / Game Room Plaza minigame (only Training Camp confirmed solo-capable).
Toad Brigade rank ladder naming/order not fully cross-confirmed.
Two review sources (TechRadar, NintendoLife patch notes) could not be fetched and may hold more detail.
missables: None found that are permanently missable — courses are replayable, and within a single course run collecting the 3rd Flower Coin without touching the Wonder Flower just requires a replay to also get that course's Wonder Seed (not a permanent loss).
